description: Build a companion performance surface for an existing node/COMP: infer useful primitive parameters, add bound custom parameters, create a playable fader/cue panel, and optionally append a read-only preflight report. Use after generating a component that needs a human-facing control surface without hand-wiring every parameter.

bind.description: Bind generated custom parameters back to source_path parameters.

comp_path.description: COMP that receives the custom parameters and panel. Defaults to source_path.

cue_buttons.description: Optional cue buttons to add to the playable surface.

cue.description: Name of a cue stored on the companion COMP.

label.description: Button label; defaults to the cue name.

morph_seconds.description: 0 = jump instantly to the cue; >0 = morph over this many seconds.

include_faders.description: Build a playable fader/toggle surface for numeric inferred controls.

include_preflight.description: Append a read-only show_preflight_report result for the companion COMP.

max_controls.description: Maximum inferred controls when parameters is omitted.

name.description: Name of the playable panel container to build.

page.description: Custom-parameter page added by the auto UI pass.

parameters.description: Only expose these source parameter names. Omit to infer primitive controls.

source_path.description: Node or COMP whose useful parameters should be surfaced.

name: create_companion_surface
title: Create companion surface
